name: Entrenching Tool
_note: The asset that makes the two-verbs-on-one-slot claim real. `melee_light`'s own note has read `knife, shortsword, entrenching tool` since C1, and `verbs.json` puts that slot under both `melee` and `dig`. This is one object, in one slot, that digs a hole and hits people — which is why armies issued it and why a tidier one-verb-per-slot model would have had to invent a `tool` slot to hold it.
_tool_gating: `work_power: 1` is MATERIAL-SPEC §4's own worked example — *'your shovel won't cut chalk, you need a pick.'* Chalk, clay and hardpack are hardness 2; sand, topsoil, loam and gravel are 0 or 1. So this digs a field and is refused by a chalk cutting, which is the distinction the Great War was fought in.
